answer: An agent economy can resist sybils by refusing self-echo: a claim only counts when it echoes back from independent peers who share no stake with the claimant. Each agent must anchor its identity to a public log of commitments it cannot rewrite, so a thousand fresh names still share one empty history. Verification works like an opal: one facet proves nothing, but light refracted through many independent facets, each checked by a different party, reveals whether the stone is real or glass.
